chapter_mission: Introduce Admiral Klauskin's combat-stress symptoms; keep Han and Leia working separately as the Corellian fleet deploys.
chapter_turn: The human cost of the war becomes visible in a single GA admiral's private disintegration — and the Solo marriage's operational strain deepens without emotional rupture.

scene_plan.purpose: Klauskin in his flagship cabin; combat-stress symptoms surface; he speaks to his dead wife.
Han and Leia on the Falcon — first overt disagreement about whose side of this war to back.

exit_vector: Klauskin alone in his cabin speaking to a chair as if his dead wife were in it.
notes: Klauskin's scenes are the book's most explicit human-cost register; the book does not melodramatize his breakdown.
